title: The battle against Chick Webb at the Savoy and the Carnegie Hall night
summary: Jones recalls the January 1937 battle of music with Chick Webb, Ella and Billie, the same night as Goodman's Carnegie Hall concert, and Ellington at the Criterion.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: played the battle of music against Chick Webb -
In 1937, January 1937. Yes I have tapes and I have pictures because Chick had Ella, we had Billie. And everybody - the dancers - everybody was looking.....

At the Savoy Ballroom. It happened the same night that Mr. Benny Goodman was playing at Carnegie Hall, doing his jazz concert, because Zutty, Gene Krupa, came up at the battle. Meanwhile I went down with the Basie rhythm section to play with Benny at Carnegie Hall, but Walter Page, Freddie, and Basie played in the Benny band. I did not. And Buck played. It's on the records that they finally re-issued. This is January 1937. But after the concert I went on back up to the place, but after the concert we got in a taxi and come up there, we still continued and Chick Webb was playing and Basie's band was playing. It was a very memorial night. Matter of fact it was a memorial day because at the Criterion Theatre, Mr. Duke Ellington woke up New York at 10 o'clock at the Criterion Theatre - he opened up with the East St. Louis 'Toodle-Oo' and New York did not go to sleep until 7 or 8 o'clock in the morning. It started on a Sunday morning and on a Monday they did not go to sleep. Everybody just stayed awake. I never will forget that the that Martin Black because there was a time in my life I had the thing going

and - they had the bands to play at the Criterion Theatre. Every week they would have different things. That's the time little Mitzi Green was a very popular singer. She could sing in 3 or 4 different languages. She was a fore-runner - she was a petite like Thelma Carpenter. She was before Miss Lena Horne and people like that because she could sing in the different languages. I never knew what happened to her after that because we got caught up in the fog.
